summary.key_theme: 儘管近期因高利率與庫存壓力導致股價觸及 52 週新低，但分析師開始上調評級，顯示市場對其長期基本面與政策利多仍存有期待。

bullish.title: KeyBanc Just Upgraded First Solar Stock. Here's Why.
bullish.reason: KeyBanc 分析師 Sophie Karp 將評級從「減持」上調至「產業權重」，此舉顯著改善了市場對該股的悲觀情緒，並帶動股價反彈。

bullish.title: FSLR Stock Heads For Its Worst Week In Over A Month — Roth Says US Polysilicon Crackdown Could Provide A Tailwind
bullish.reason: Roth 分析師指出美國對多晶矽的進口限制將成為 First Solar 的長期順風，有助於緩解庫存壓力並提升競爭優勢。

bearish.title: Solar Stocks Slide as High Borrowing Costs Weigh on Project Financing: First Solar Sinks 8%
bearish.reason: 10 年期公債殖利率飆升至 5.14 %，導致太陽能專案融資成本激增，直接衝擊 First Solar 等類股的估值與獲利預期。

bearish.title: First Solar Faces Pricing Pressure Amid High Inventory, Slow Project Starts, KeyBanc Says
bearish.reason: KeyBanc 指出美國市場庫存水位過高且專案啟動緩慢，導致中短期內面臨定價壓力，影響利潤率表現。

bearish.title: Piper Sandler Maintains Overweight on First Solar, Lowers Price Target to $251
bearish.reason: 儘管維持「增持」評級，但 Piper Sandler 下調目標價至 251 美元，反映了對近期市場環境與獲利成長放緩的擔憂。

bearish.title: FSLR Stock Hits Fresh 52-Week Low As Target Cuts, Slower Booking Visibility Weigh
bearish.reason: GLJ Research 將目標價大幅下調至 250 美元，加上訂單能見度下降，導致股價跌破 52 週新低，引發市場恐慌性拋售。

bearish.title: First Solar: Why The Market Still Doesn't Believe The Story (Rating Downgrade)
bearish.reason: 市場對該公司基本面仍存疑，認為當前的折價反映了產業風險，投資人信心尚未完全恢復。

neutral.title: Investors Heavily Search First Solar, Inc. (FSLR): Here is What You Need to Know
neutral.reason: 僅為 Zacks.com 使用者搜尋熱度統計，未提供具體財務或營運基本面變動資訊。
